description: This file defines a React component and a class for providing command suggestions in a chat application, including handling user input, fetching command suggestions, and rendering suggestion UI.

classes.name: CommandProvider
classes.description: A class extending Provider that manages command suggestions, user input handling, and integration with app commands.

methods.name: setProps
methods.description: Updates the component's properties and channel context.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the input pretext, fetches suggestions, and determines UI updates.

methods.name: handleCompleteWord
methods.description: Completes the current word with a space.

methods.name: handleMobile
methods.description: Fetches command suggestions for mobile interface.

methods.name: handleWebapp
methods.description: Fetches command suggestions for web interface.

methods.name: shouldAddExecuteItem
methods.description: Determines if the 'execute current command' option should be added to suggestions.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a list of suggestions contains a specific complete command.
